Creating a Migration Project
This API is used to signing the privacy agreement.
This API is used to create a migration task for a source server.
This API is used to create a template for launching target servers.
This API is used to delete a migration project by ID.

This API is used to delete the record of a source server with the specified ID from the SMS console. Once the record of a source server is deleted, you can add the source server to SMS only by restarting the Agent installed on the source server.

This API is used to delete source server records in batches. Once the record of a source server is deleted, you can add the source server to SMS only by restarting the Agent installed on the source server.
This API is used to delete a migration task by ID.
This API is used to batch delete migration tasks.
This API is used to delete a server template by ID.
This API is used to batch delete templates with specified IDs.
This API is used to export consistency verification results in batches.
This API is used to list all SMS API versions.
This API is used to list the source servers that failed to be migrated and the reported error messages.
SMS enables you to use migration projects to manage source servers. This API is used to list all migration projects in an account.
After the Agent installed on a source server is started, the Agent registers the source server with SMS. This API is used to list the registered source servers.
After the target server is configured for a source server, SMS automatically creates a migration task. This API is used to list all your migration tasks.
This API is used to list templates used for launching target servers. You can a template to quickly configure target servers when you create migration tasks

This API is automatically called by the Agent to register the source server with SMS. After the source server is registered successfully, you can view the source server information on the SMS console.
This API is used to query a specified API version of SMS.

For a source server running Windows, the Agent installed on the source server communicates with target server through an SSL socket. This API is used to download the certificate and private key in PEM format from SMS.
This API is called by the Agent installed on source servers to obtain commands from SMS.
After the Agent installed on a source server is started, it calls this API to obtain the configuration-required information.
This API is used to query the settings of advanced migration options of a task.
This API is used to obtain the brief consistency verification results of a task.
This API is used to query details about a migration project with a specified ID.
This API is used to get source server statistics.
This API is used to query the certificate passphrase of the secure transmission channel in a task.
This API is used to query whether a user has signed the privacy agreement.

After the Agent reports the source server information to SMS, SMS checks the migration feasibility of the source server. This API is used to query the basic information and check results of the source server.
This API is used to calculate SHA256 values. The value of the encrypted field must be in the UUID format.
This API is used to query the target server passwords configured in a template.
This API is used to query a migration task by ID.
This API is used to query information about a server template by ID.
This API is used to query the time segment-based migration rate limit rules of a migration task.
This API is used to unlock a target server in a migration task.
This API is called by the Agent to send the execution result of a specified command to SMS.
This API is called by the Agent to report the consistency verification results of a task.
Updating the Migration Task Status of a Source Server
This API is used to change the default migration project. If you change the default migration project, new source servers will be registered under the changed project.
This API is used to update the disk information of a source server. After you call this API successfully, the new disk information will take effect, and the original disk information will be deleted.
This API is used to modify a migration project.
The API is called by the Agent to report network measurement information.
This API is used to modify the information of a source server displayed on the SMS console to facilitate source server management.
This API is used to set migration rate limit rules for a migration task.
This API is used to update a migration task by ID.
This API is called by the Agent installed on source servers during migration to report the migration progress and rate to SMS. You do not need to make calls to this API.
This API is used to manage a migration task, including starting, pausing, synchronizing, rolling back a task,clearing snapshots, and uploading logs.
This API is used to modify a server template.
This API is used to configure advanced migration options for a task, for example, specifying the files or paths to be synchronized.
